decks.notes: This Jeskai Aggro deck focuses on utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Amped Raptor, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge, to control the board and deal damage quickly. The inclusion of cards like Static Prison and Expressive Iteration helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage. The deck also features a unique companion in Jegantha, the Wellspring, adding an additional element of versatility and synergy. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creatures, burn spells, and disruption.

The main focus of this deck is on disruption and control, using a combination of counterspells, removal, and hand disruption to control the game. The deck also utilizes cards that can surveil, allowing the player to filter their draws and get rid of unwanted cards. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and control the board until the player can establish a dominant position and ultimately win the game. It also includes a mix of creatures to pressure the opponent while maintaining a defensive stance.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats, and disrupting their strategy. It utilizes a mix of counter spells, removal spells, and card draw to maintain board control and out-value the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive creatures like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus to pressure the opponent. The mana base is optimized to support a variety of spells and ensure smooth gameplay. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and ultimately win through card advantage and efficient control.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain control over the game while applying constant pressure on the opponent through quick and efficient creatures and burn spells. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide early threats, supported by countermagic like Counterspell and disruption like Unholy Heat. Murktide Regent serves as a powerful finisher. The deck also includes card selection and card advantage tools like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain consistency and tempo. This deck aims to be aggressive while maintaining a strong defense against threats from the opponent.

The primary strategy of this deck is to quickly assemble the Amulet Titan combo by utilizing Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and generate extra mana. The deck includes various land cards such as Simic Growth Chamber and Gruul Turf to enable multiple land drops per turn, allowing for explosive plays with Primeval Titan. The deck also includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Tolaria West to search for key combo pieces. Additionally, cards like Arboreal Grazer and Explore help ramp up to the combo while Malevolent Rumble provides disruption against opponent's strategies.

The focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently set up a combo using Underworld Breach and various cheap artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Amber to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help with card selection and recursion, while cards like Malevolent Rumble and Unholy Heat provide disruption and removal. The end goal is to use Breach to cast Thassa's Oracle or generate infinite mana with Grinding Station to win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck revolves around cycling creatures and using cards like Living End to bring them back onto the battlefield all at once, overwhelming the opponent with a powerful board presence. It also utilizes cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation to control the board and protect its combo pieces. With a mix of cycling creatures, countermagic, and card advantage engines, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own lethal combo finish.

The focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively swarm the board with creatures in order to deal damage quickly to the opponent. Utilizing a combination of powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Amped Raptor, along with support cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison, this deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to set up their own strategy. With a mix of removal, disruption, and aggressive threats, this Mardu Aggro deck aims to win the game through sheer speed and efficiency.

This deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful combo by utilizing instant reanimation spells in combination with creatures and other spells that interact positively with the graveyard. By reanimating threats such as Griselbrand and Ulamog, the Defiler, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and win the game. The inclusion of cards like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize helps to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Solitude and Psychic Frog provide additional utility in the form of removal and card draw.

The main goal of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of powerful control cards like Supreme Verdict, Force of Negation, and Teferi, Time Raveler, while also leveraging the unique abilities of The One Ring to disrupt your opponent's strategy and gain an advantage. The deck focuses on using a mix of removal, counterspells, and card draw to maintain board control and outvalue your opponent. With a strong mana base and a mix of powerful creatures and spells, this deck aims to dominate the game and secure victory through patient and strategic play.

The deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent using a combination of powerful creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, Amped Raptor, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, backed up by burn spells like Lightning Bolt. The inclusion of Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury adds additional threat to the board. The deck also has utility cards like Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's mana base and Arena of Glory to give your creatures a boost. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands like Arid Mesa and Marsh Flats, as well as mana-fixing lands like Sacred Foundry and Aether Hub.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble a winning combo without relying on traditional lands. By utilizing cards that manipulate the opponent's hand, counter spells, and combo pieces like Goblin Charbelcher and Lotus Bloom, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up for a game-winning play. With a mix of disruption, card manipulation, and combo potential, this Landless Combo deck offers a unique and fast-paced strategy in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of cards to quickly assemble and cast powerful spells without relying on traditional lands. By utilizing cards like Flare of Denial, Beyeen Veil, and Thundertrap Trainer, the deck aims to disrupt opponent's strategies while efficiently searching for and casting key spells such as Hydroelectric Specimen and Whir of Invention. With a focus on combo potential and resource management, this landless deck relies on precise timing and clever card interactions to achieve victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The main idea of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and graveyard interaction. The deck aims to control the board through targeted removal, counter key spells from the opponent, and generate card advantage through cantrips and reusable spells like Snapcaster Mage. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with Unearth and Cling to Dust to stay ahead in resources and maintain control over the game. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing creatures with fast attack capabilities and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. It also includes cards that provide additional damage for each creature you control, as well as ways to protect your creatures from removal spells. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional value to the deck by providing a free mana source. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells to secure a quick victory.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. The key strategy is to maintain a fast-paced offense while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Static Prison. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides an additional boost to the deck's mana base, allowing for explosive plays. The deck aims to apply pressure early and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize, utilizing powerful creatures and spells like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury.
